privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Database service for user stats operations

privateVars.name: debounceTimeouts
privateVars.description: Map tracking debounce timers per userId-mediaType key

functions.name: recalculate
functions.description: Debounced wrapper around doRecalculate. Clears any existing debounce timer for the user/mediaType pair and schedules recalculation after 5 seconds.

functions.name: doRecalculate
functions.description: Performs full stats recalculation for a user and media type. Looks up the user, dispatches to the correct private calculator method based on media type (anime, manga, tv, movie, game, book), and upserts the result into userStats.

functions.name: calculateScoreStats
functions.description: Calculates score distribution, mean score, and standard deviation from an array of scores
returnValues: { scoreDistribution: Record<string, number>, meanScore: number, standardDeviation: number }

functions.name: calculateAnimeStats
functions.description: Calculates anime statistics including episode counts, watch time, score distributions, format/status/country distributions, and episode count distributions

functions.name: calculateMangaStats
functions.description: Calculates manga statistics including chapter/volume counts, score distributions, format/status/country distributions, and chapter count distributions

functions.name: calculateTvStats
functions.description: Calculates TV statistics including episode counts, watch time, score distributions, and status/country distributions

functions.name: calculateMovieStats
functions.description: Calculates movie statistics including runtime, watch time, score distributions, and status/country distributions

functions.name: calculateGameStats
functions.description: Calculates game statistics including play time, score distributions, and platform/genre/status distributions

functions.name: calculateBookStats
functions.description: Calculates book statistics including chapter/volume/page counts, score distributions, and status distributions
